headline: Your data, your control—how we handle your information with transparency and care
universal_truth: Trust is built through transparency; you deserve to know how your data is used
fun_facts: We only collect data that improves your learning experience
Your learning progress is private—we don't share it with anyone
You can export or delete your data anytime
discussion_questions: How do you feel about your data being used by services?
What privacy concerns do you have?
What would make you feel secure about your information?

hook.script: Your data matters. How it's collected, stored, and used matters. I want to be transparent about how we handle your information—because trust is earned through honesty, not hidden policies.

cliff.script: Every service collects some data. What makes data handling trustworthy?

options.text: Transparency, minimization, and control—we tell you what we collect and why, we only collect what's necessary, and you control your own data
options.response: Exactly. No hidden tracking. No selling your data. No surprises. We collect what helps your learning experience and give you full control over it.
We have a policy, but this lesson explains it simply. No one should need a lawyer to understand their data rights...

fact1.title: What We Collect
fact1.script: We collect account info to identify you, learning progress to track your journey, and usage patterns to improve the product. That's it. No selling to advertisers. No data brokers.

fact2.title: Your Control
fact2.script: You can export all your data anytime. You can delete your account and data. You can adjust privacy settings. Your data belongs to you—we just steward it while you're here.

fact3.title: Our Commitment
fact3.script: We're a Public Benefit Corporation. That means education mission over profit motive. Respecting your privacy isn't just policy—it's principle. We succeed when you trust us.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Trust is earned through transparency and action. We aim to be worthy of your trust with your data and your learning journey.

outro.script: Review your privacy settings if you'd like more control. And if you have questions, ask. Your peace of mind matters to us.

growTrack.title: Privacy Review - Check Your Settings
growTrack.activity: Review your privacy settings in your account. Understand what data we have and how it's used. Adjust settings to your comfort level. Knowledge is power—know your data.
